commit_binding: every archive member is re-hashed against the working tree at build time (verify_against_tree); the source commit and dirty state are recorded in release/verification.json
manifest_scope: all _included() source/evidence files; release/ and evidence/release/build_record.json are out-of-band and never inventoried into the archive
post_build_verification: release/verification.json — outside the archive by construction
